comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Persist the converged base on the normal matrix path**

When an A-to-B matrix convergence succeeds without requiring a later validation or replay repair, this helper is never reached because it is called only through `checkpointDirtyCandidate`, while the matrix integration has already committed a clean candidate. The durable `implementation_running` record therefore retains A, and the issue pre-push check rejects it against the cycle base B, so the original convergence failure remains on the successful path. Persist the proven execution base immediately after matrix integration rather than only when a subsequent repair creates another checkpoint.
